fusions.name: Rooted Spore
fusions.desc: Throws a strand that deals 10 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Spore Drift
fusions.desc: Puffs a cone of spores ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelial Weave
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Spreading Rot
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% poison resistance for as long as you carry it.
